faqs.q1: Do I need a credit card for the trial period?
faqs.a1: No. The 14-day trial is completely free and requires no payment details. You start with no commitment.
faqs.q2: Can I change plans at any time?
faqs.a2: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade whenever you want. Changes apply in the next billing cycle at no extra cost.
faqs.q3: What happens to my data if I cancel?
faqs.a3: You have 30 days to export all your data after cancelling. We never delete anything without notifying you first.
faqs.q4: How many users can I add?
faqs.a4: SalesFlow and StockFlow include 1 user. The Full Suite includes up to 10. You can add additional users for €9/month each.
faqs.a5: Prices shown do not include VAT. For companies in the EU the applicable VAT will be added.
faqs.a6: The Bridge is the automatic connection between CRM and inventory. When you close a sale, stock updates automatically. If it falls below minimum, the supplier order is generated automatically.
